title: Submarine Attack
description: Command a submarine, destroy enemy ships with torpedoes, unlock new weapons, and conquer the ocean. Engage in thrilling naval battles, use unique abilities, face numerous enemies, and wield powerful armaments to achieve victory.

title: AOD - Art Of Defense
description: Step into the world of AOD - Art Of Defense, a free online strategy game where your main goal is to stop enemy waves by placing towers in smart locations. Play on your phone or computer and test your skills in this action-packed defense challenge. Every move matters—can you build the perfect defense?

title: Zombie Survival Shooter
description: Ready for an all-out apocalypse escape? Zombie Survival Shooter throws you straight into a world overrun by zombies. Zombies attack from every direction. Keep moving, dodge smartly, and never stop running. Shoot the digital doors to gain more helpers or boost your attack speed, etc. Use your strategy to choose which digital door to go through.

title: Space Blast
description: Space Blast is a 2D game full of action arcade game where your piloting skills and strategic thinking are key to navigating relentless waves of meteors. Command a powerful spaceship equipped with advanced weapons and take on the challenge of protecting the galaxy from incoming threats.

title: Marble Blast
description: Ready to match, blast, and conquer? This vibrant marble shooter game offers endless fun and challenges that test your skills and strategy. Clear colorful marbles, unlock powerful boosters, and prove you’re the master of marble puzzles! Whether you’re a casual gamer or a puzzle enthusiast, this game delivers excitement like no other.

title: Dinosaur Eggs Pop
description: Come back to the Jurassic era with me to hear the story of Dinosaur - the cutest dinosaur babysitter of the Bubble Jungle. It’s free, no download, endless, high quality, and easy to play for relaxation.

title: Mafia Sniper Crime Shooting
description: Ready to become the coldest, deadliest sniper in the entire city? Mafia Sniper Crime Shooting is a FPS action shooting simulator where you complete high-risk missions. Use powerful guns to eliminate dangerous mafia targets.

title: Cannon Shooter
description: Cannon Shooter is an exciting arcade shooter where you can have endless shooting fun in fast-paced combat! You will control a cannonball firing hordes of heroic characters, facing many enemies. A quick click to launch more heroes and help you generate more heroes through the digital gate.

title: Bowmasters
description: Bowmasters is a fun and action-packed game that combines creative physics with exciting Archery gameplay. Use different types of bows and weapons. Draw your weapon, judge the angle, and fire arrows to hit all enemies. The game shines with its physics-based mechanics, where timing, distance, and trajectory matter. You’ll need real skill and smart thinking to solve each shooting puzzle and land accurate hits. Every match feels different thanks to unique characters and varied weapons.

title: Polygon Space
description: Polygon Space is an intense shooting challenge. Fly a laser cannon in space, battle attacking sci-fi shapes, keep firing, upgrade weapons with resources, destroy them all, and stay safe.

title: Cool Archer
description:
Aim for the target and show your archery skills in this beautiful 3D archery challenge.

Time and adjust your archer shots to land a bullseye and get bigger points.

Your skills will be tested with harder challenges over time like moving boards and stronger winds.

Master the game and become the bowmaster.

title: One HERO
description:
One Hero: Dive into the ultimate action-packed shooting game! Play as a lone hero, dodging and shooting your way through waves of enemies. Eliminate all foes to claim victory. Are you ready to be the last one standing?
Dive into a thrilling, action-packed adventure where you’ll face waves of enemies and intense boss battles.
With intuitive controls and accessible gameplay, players of all skill levels can jump in and start unleashing chaos in no time.

title: Shooting Balls
description:
Shooting Balls is a casual and super fun game.
The objective is to destroy as many blocks as possible and reach the highest score.
Challenge your friends to see who can get the highest score!

title: Gun Evolution
description: Gun Evolution is both a shooting running game and a strategy merge battle game. With 3D cartoon models, you need to merge a power gun to win the battle after the finish line at each level. I recommend shooting the numbered pillars, you can claim money inside and get the items on them. When you earn enough money, you can upgrade the ATK and Speed to destroy more pillars more easily on the track. Good luck!

title: Fury Tanks
description: Beyond the hills and forests, war waits in silence. When it starts, it’s you, your tank and the enemy in your sights. Build your armor, power up your cannon and let instinct guide your aim. When the ground shakes, make sure it’s because you fired first.

title: Sniper Master
description: Take aim in mid-air and strike at the perfect moment! In Sniper Master, you jump, float, and fire while airborne—time your shots to eliminate targets with clean, satisfying hits. Stay calm, lead your aim, and master precision shooting across multiple levels. Earn rewards, improve your skills, and become the ultimate airborne marksman.

title: Digit Shooter
description: Digit Shooter! plays like a vertical-version shooting running arcade game. With 3D green numbers, you can launch green numbers to shoot green numbers and numbered walls. You can shoot them and collect them to make your number bigger. Don't waste bullets and time on red walls while avoiding them. When you reach the finish line, try to focus on one line to shoot, then you will collect more rewards

title: Army Defence Dino Shoot
description: Army Defence Dino Shoot is a third-person defense idle game. It seems that a lot of dinosaurs surround you. To protect the base from incoming dinosaurs, you can summon more soldiers and engineers to create a defensive line. Don't forget to upgrade your weapons, damage, and fire rate skills. The longer you hold this position, the more dinosaurs you will meet. Have a good time building a military base.

title: Christmas Shooter Game
description: Christmas Shooter is a puzzle HTML5 game. The goal of the game is to clear all the xmas balls from the level avoiding any ball crossing the bottom line.

title: Turret Gunner
description:
You will find yourself in a thrilling air battle simulation, filled with exciting moments and countless enemy targets. You’ll be able to maneuver, shoot, and fight virtual opponents, experiencing the true adrenaline rush of an airstrike.

This captivating journey into the world of aviation will leave unforgettable impressions on fans of extreme action and flying. Feel like a real pilot and enjoy the excitement of aerial combat!

title: Gun Shooting Games Sniper 3D
description: Step into the battlefield and test your precision in Gun Shooting Games: Sniper 3D, an exciting fps experience packed with nonstop action. This immersive first person shooting game puts you in the role of an elite sniper armed with powerful weapons and challenging missions.

title: Dino Shooter Pro
description: Dino Shooter Pro is an exciting gun battle game. You are on an island. There are many dinosaurs and bad guys on this island. They are extremely ferocious and attack everyone they see. Your weapon is a gun. When there are dinosaurs and bad guys around you, pick up your gun, aim at the opponent, and fire bullets in rapid succession.  Try to kill all of them, good luck!

title: Pubg Hack
description: Experience the ultimate shooting adventure. In Pubg Hack, you step into the battlefield as an elite soldier, exploring massive maps and engaging in fierce combat. Select a location to land and begin searching for supplies.

title: Tanks
description: Tanks is a fast-paced arcade shooter where you control a powerful tank and battle through maze-like stages. Destroy enemy tanks, defend your base, and survive waves of attacks. Each level introduces new challenges that require quick reflexes and smart strategy. Easy to play but hard to master, Tanks offers fun and engaging gameplay for casual players.

title: Zombie Horde: Build & Survive
description: Step into the chaos of Zombie Horde: Build & Survive, a free online game where your survival depends on smart defenses and sharp shooting. Play on your phone or computer as you fight off endless waves of the undead. Set up turrets, lay traps, and build barricades to hold the line while unleashing powerful weapons. In this post-apocalyptic world, every second counts—can you keep the horde at bay?

title: Giant Wanted Monster
description: The city is being occupied by giant monsters. You, as an elite sniper, pick up your sniper gun. Defeat these crazy monsters and protect the survival of humanity. In Giant Wanted Monster, the fate of the city is at stake with every bullet. You need to use the powerful sniper weapon to shoot accurately from a distance and hit the monster's Achilles heel.

title: Swat Force Vs Terrorists
description: Swat Force Vs Terrorists is an intense tactical shooter where players take on the role of elite SWAT team members engaging in high-stakes confrontations with terrorists. The game emphasizes teamwork and tactical coordination, requiring players to utilize professional counter-terrorism skills and equipment across various complex urban environments.

title: Squid Game: Playground Shooter
description:
In "Squid Game: Playground Shooter", every shot triggers a wave of chaos-take down all the Squid Game characters in the level and watch them fly around with crazy physics!

What’s waiting for you:
- Switch guns and enjoy unique effects with every shot.
- Each scene is a new challenge and a chance to create Squid Game-style chaos.
- Explosions, traps, interactive objects
– Instantly recognizable icons!

Dive into the shooting frenzy and ragdoll madness!

title: Real Bottle Shooter 3D
description: Real Bottle Shooter 3D  game is a simulation game where you can practice shooting with bottles. Levels continue from simple to difficult. You will need to calculate moving platforms, obstacles and distance. You should also use the limited number of bullets sparingly.

title: Choo Choo Spider Monster Train
description:
Welcome to the most terrifying train ride of your life!
Cho-Cho Scary Charles: Spider Train is a chilling open-world survival horror shooter where your only lifeline is a small yellow train armed with a machine gun and a whole lot of courage.
Face off against Charles — the monstrous spider-train hybrid that haunts a remote island, preying on unsuspecting humans. No one knows where he came from, but one thing is clear — he won't stop until he's fed.

title: Zombie Outbreak Survive
description: With this entertaining game you will have to run throughout the city, run and shoot because the zombies are fast and dangerous, they will not stop chasing you to devour you.The zombie apocalypse has arrived and the terror of surviving has arrived with this new game. Zombie Outbreak Survive is a 3D game with impressive and realistic graphics that will make your hair stand on end and you will feel the true fear of being devoured.

title: Slenderman Back to School
description: On a very mysterious night you wake up and find yourself trapped in your high school, a town in Massachusetts, and you will have to survive until dawn and escape from the urban legend Slenderman. In Slenderman Back to School, a 3D online game, you will be able to feel the adrenaline that a horror game feels like.

title: Skibidi Toilet vs Cameraman Sniper Game
description: Camera man are trying to survive in toilet mans red light green light game. If there is a camera man moving when the toilet man says red light, you must destroy him with your sniper gun. When aiming, you have to make sure you hit the right player. If you shoot the correct player, you earn additional points. Compete with your friends by getting the highest score. Play Toilet vs Cameraman Sniper now!

title: Archer Legend
description: Play Archery Battle Legend, the ultimate bow and arrow game! Test your aim in exciting archery battles, shoot targets, and defeat enemies like a true archer hero. Perfect for US students searching “archery game,” “stickman archer,” or “cool math games bow and arrow,” this free online challenge mixes skill, action, and fun. With endless levels, epic duels, and fast arrow shooting, sharpen your skills and become the legendary archer everyone talks about!

title: Super Spy Agent 46
description:
We all known, agent 47, but the figure agent 46 had been more popular in alter verse, more deadly, more louder and definitely more then just a beast when it comes to taking the hordes of enemies
46 is a paid assassin and a clone. He gets his name from being the 46th clone created from the DNA of five different men, made to be perfect spies who could easily maintain peak physicality and intelligence for many years while easily being controlled by whoever they were devoted to, usually a handler.

title: Donut Shooter
description: A fun game which you will match all the same donuts and to pop them before they pass through line. The sweetness in this game depends on your play so match them as you can. Enjoy!

title: Ballistic Breakthrough
description: explore lush scenes, tackle tricky obstacles, and unlock upgrades. Every level blends fun challenges with strategic boosts

title: Neon Blast
description: Upgrade your defense cannons by merging them!Watch as your cannons level up and become powerful defenders, and get exciting new powers to crush bosses and attackers!

title: Dead Zone Mech Ops
description:
Dead Zone: Mech Ops thrusts players into the heart of a scorched Earth ravaged by endless war, where autonomous factions and rogue AI compete for control over the planet’s last remaining strongholds. You are a combat pilot in the elite “Mech Ops” unit — the final line of defense in a world on the brink of total collapse.
Players will command next-gen combat exosuits equipped with modular weapon systems, advanced targeting tech, and adaptive armor that reacts to battlefield conditions.

title: Hitman Sniper
description: Step into the icy chaos of Tundra Sniper, an adrenaline-fueled first-person shooter where precision and speed are your best weapons. Take on the role of an elite sniper tasked with taking down dangerous criminals and restoring peace to the city.

title: Shoot N Crush
description: Unleash your shooting skills and break bricks in Shoot N Crush. This game is the best choice for your leisure time. Your goal is to shoot with precision and flexibility. Use the bouncing ball to smash a solid brick with precision. Each level has a different objective and difficulty, you need to break these bricks in the smartest way possible.

title: Nubik in the Monster World
description:
Nubik saved the kittens, but the monsters are back! Evil Huggy has kidnapped them again!
Now Nubik has new weapons: AK-47, M16, grenade launcher, machine gun, and shotguns!
Help him rescue the kittens, collect loot, earn coins, upgrade, blast TNT, and escape traps. Even his friend gets captured—help Nubik save him too!

title: Gun Shooting Range
description: In this game, you are a rookie sniper at the beginning, take your rifle, pass all the missions,and grow into a professional sniper! Remember, shoot every bullet calmly, be accurate and fatal,and use the least bullets to do the biggest damage.

title: Bunny Boy Online
description: Play the exciting online game. Variety of weapons, grenades, maps to choose from, various game modes, dynamic gameplay. Play with friends to the game!

title: The Office Escape
description: The Office Escape is an exciting adventure where every step towards freedom becomes a test for the Regime and the thinking factor!

title: C.A.P.
description:
Take to the skies and protect the carrier in this shooter inspired by WW2 dogfights. 
Dodge enemy fighters, protect your aircraft carrier, and blast through waves of incoming planes. 
Remember to come back to the carrier to refuel!
With crisp pixel-art 3D visuals and one-touch controls, this shooter delivers satisfying action perfect for short play.

title: Christmas Survival
description:
Features
• Christmas theme
• Multiplayer or single-player gameplay
• Multiple game modes
• In-game weapons and armor shop

title: Easter Shooter Game
description: Easter Shooter is a classic HTML5 game. The goal of the game is to clear all the easter eggs from the level avoiding any egg crossing the bottom line.

title: Zombie Terminator
description: Zombie Terminator is an exciting first-person shooter game where players take on the role of a survivor in a world overrun by a zombie outbreak. Players must survive and hunt zombies in this post-apocalyptic setting. The game attracts numerous players with its intense combat experience and rich weapon system.

title: Farm vs Zombies
description: The undead are hungry, but this farmer isn't backing down! Plant mutant defenses, harvest resources in real-time, and protect your homestead in this addictive strategy survival game.

title: Zombie Survival
description: A strange virus outbreak turned your friends into zombies Armed with a basic pistol make your way through hordes of zombiesHow many days can you survive before you become one of themFeatures D like isometric graphics Multiple weapons to purchase Try the machine gun shotgun rifle and laser gun  different gameplay modes Survival Hard Point and Nuke

title: Cam and Leon Donut Hop
description: Brought to you by the creators of a D animation Cam and Leon Donut Hop features  funny and cute characters hopping their way around the parkHop in and out of donuts but dont hit the obstaclesFeatures Interactive tutorial Easy to play hard to master Increasingly challenging obstacles Unlock different characters as you progress Gain access to Leon Ladybird Ice Cube and Pepper Shaker

title: Block Craft 3d
description: Block Craft 3D is a first-person RPG game with 3D pixel Minecraft models. Starting from a block base, you can attack the monsters outside to claim diamonds with weapons. I strongly suggest you build bombs to destroy terrains or build blocks to make yourself safe. When you earn enough diamonds, you can unlock and use 4 Melee weapons, 11 guns, and 8 bombs in the store. Glad you will have a good time in this block world.

title: Archery Master - Bow and Arrow
description:
Join archery adventure and become a bowmaster! Aim, shoot and hit the bullseye!

Pick your bow, defeat other archery masters and don’t let them take you down! Join in this fun and challenging adventure and have fun. Bow masters can really challenge your casual game skills but have no fear! If you enjoy bow and arrow games, then prepare to defeat other bow masters, earn coins, score, and become the ultimate bow master!

title: GenFire
description:
GenFire is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter where players fight endless waves of enemies in intense 360° combat.

Survive increasingly difficult levels, defeat elemental creatures, and collect coins while mastering your strategy.

Features:
- 20 handcrafted levels across multiple chapters
- Unique enemy mechanics including splitting fire slimes and bosses
- Skill-based gameplay with increasing difficulty

title: Bottle Shooting Game
description:
Looking for a bottle shooting game? Then Catapult Game is the ultimate bottle shooting game, you are looking for.

Play Catapult Game, a fun and addictive bottle shoot slingshot game that will provide you with hours of fun! Knock down to Earth colorful bottles in order to break them, challenge your skills and progress in multiple levels! Your new favorite bottle shoot & bottle breaking game!

KNOCK DOWN THE BOTTLES TO EARTH
With this easy to play and fun bottle breaker catapult game, you will have endless fun testing your slingshot skills! Have fun playing and breaking all the bottles using angry ball in front of you!

CHALLENGE YOUR SKILLS IN DIFFERENT LEVELS
Our Catapult game offers different challenging levels for you to test your slingshot skills. You get to challenge yourself in 36 levels. In each level of this bottle game, you need to use your logic in order to knock down all the bottles and you get to progress in another even more challenging levels if you succeed to break all the bottles in that level. As you progress in this game, the game play becomes more and more challenging, giving you the chance to become the ultimate player. 

Game has 3 beautiful worlds Forest, Dessert & Snow with different weather themes.

title: Zombie Head
description: Help these poor zombies recover their heads after a wild party on Halloween night To do this destroy blocks avoid obstacles use dynamite and get the heads roll up to their corresponding bodies Will you be able to collect all the stars in each level

title: Cat vs Kripotians
description:
In the game, we have to help Kitty save his people from the terrible Kripotians.       
In this difficult task, we will have an unexpected green ally!       
Beautiful levels, interesting dialogues and of course a lot of enemies and a lot of shooting! ! The game has both difficult and simple missions and even timed missions! All this together creates an atmosphere of a game that does not let go until the very end!

title: Squid Challenge: Play to Survive
description: Squid Challenge: Play to Survive is an intense survival game inspired by the thrilling challenges of the popular survival contest. Players must navigate through a series of deadly trials, testing their reflexes, strategy, and nerve. With each level, the difficulty increases, making it a true test of skill and endurance.

title: Tank Shootout
description: Tank shootout is an interesting skill based shooting game. Destroy all the targets to complete a level. Use mouse or touch input, to set the speed and direction of bullet to chase the target successfully.  You will get limited number of bullets for each level so use them wisely to win it. You can take the help of power panel to see the current power and last shot’s power. Mini map shows the position of target, the location where the previous shot reached etc.

title: Zombie Slayer
description: The Zombie Slayer game is a survival game that includes various missions. Sometimes you will protect a hostage and sometimes a line. Don't forget to improve your weapons to continue in a total of 100 different levels. In difficult times, use grenades and air strikes!

title: Guns & Bottles
description:
Guns and Bottles is an awesome bottle shooting game in which you need to shoot the rotating bottles to get a high score. The gun is also rotating on his spot which makes the game little harder. Tap on the screen in order to hit the bottles.  

But try to avoid hitting red bottles. If you hit them the game will over. 
Collect coins to unlock super guns.

title: The Halloween Shooter
description: Halloween Shooter is a HTML5 classic arcade game. The goal of the game is to clear all the pumpkins from the level avoiding any pumpkin crossing the bottom line.

title: Bitcoin Man Madness
description:
Every one know bitcoin as new Crypto currency trend, but now they would be able to play the bitcoin man, in cheeky shooting environment, where they can roam around, Decentralized space where fiat currencies values have to be pegged down with bullish market trend of bitcoin and you will see all bull flag action here.

Bitcoin Man Madness is fun game, for bitcoin lovers, holders with some great action for all ages.

Production of TastyCherryGames.com

title: Flip The Gun
description: Your job is to flip the gun to move up endlessly. Before you run out of bullets you have to collect bullets and coins. If you want to unlock more guns then you must collect more and more coins.

title: Merge Gun Fps Shooting Zombie
description: Merge Gun: FPS Shooting Zombie's main mission is to shoot down all coming undead creatures before they kill you. Before you join the battle, you can buy more guns and merge the same guns into new advanced ones. With more powerful and fast ammo in the clip, you can deal with incoming enemies more easily. Both zombies and crows will move forward to you even if you are still reloading. Keep calm and shoot the explosive oil cans on the ground if necessary.

title: Tap-Hold
description: Tap & Hold is a fast-paced neon cyberpunk flight arcade game. Hold to fly up, release to fall down. Navigate through dangerous obstacles, collect coins, grab power-ups, and unlock unique characters. How far can you fly?

title: Sprunki Shooter 2025
description: Sprunki Shooter 2025 is a free to play online game that delivers exciting shooting action in a colorful and challenging world. Players must navigate through each level, clearing obstacles and defeating enemies to reach the exit. The goal is to complete all levels by unlocking the exit doors. To do this, players must shoot and collect all the scattered diamonds while avoiding or eliminating dangerous enemies along the way. Have fun!

title: Fish Shooter
description: Fish Shooter is a simple match game shoot in  or more balls with same colors and get high score Made in html Enjoy the gameVisit repgamescom for more enjoyable games

title: Blast The Ball
description: Have an experience full of excitement and strategy! explode the targeted number of balls by shooting in 100 different levels. test your skills with 10 different weapons and 4 bonuses. Use your speed and tactics to get the highest score.

title: Sheep Sheep Duck
description: Sheep Sheep Duck is a very novel casual multiplayer party interactive game. You are free to choose and match the battle scenarios to your liking. The game has all kinds of cool scenes. You can control the game character flexibly by tapping directly on the screen, and take more challenges here. Show off your ability to defeat more enemies in this game, so you can get more weapons. You can challenge yourself better with great strength, so you can unlock new game maps.

title: Paint Shooter
description:
Create and find your own way to shoot and paint all white 3d shapes!
Aim at the objects and try to shoot as much as possible to reach the next level.
Shoot to explode huge amount of beautiful colorful shapes!
Explore more than 100 amazing and challenging levels and try to complete them all!
Good luck

title: Endless Zombies
description: You job is to survive on zombie hunted land. You can pickup health and bullets by finding the Ammo and Health kit. Kill maximum zombies you can.

title: Super Tank Hero
description: Super Tank Hero is an action shooting game. You can drive a tank to shoot and fight on the battlefield, usually facing seven enemies and obstacles. You need to collect soldiers before the battle, they'll join your team and help you fight. You can also find energy and Life on the battlefield to increase your speed or power. When you are able to fight, follow the instructions to find your opponent and fire at him until you beat him.

title: Color Shooting
description: Get ready for a fun and endless shooting adventure! Shoot the balls with the right colors and make your highest score. Have fun with color shooting game.

title: Santa Gift Shooter
description: Use Candy cannon to shoot all of the Gifts on each level. Each candy costs money so you'll need to shoot all of the gifts on a level before you run out of money. Shoot the bonus items to help you get more money or powerful shots.

title: Zombies And Skeletons Coloring
description: Zombies And Skeletons Coloring is a free online coloring and kids game! In this game you will find eight different pictures which have to be colored as fast as you can to obtain a great score at the end of the game. You have 23 different colors to choose. You can also save the colored image. Have fun!

title: STELLAR GUARDIAN
description: Stellar Guardian – Cosmic Defense Force is a fast-paced space shooter where you command powerful ships, unlock upgrades, and defend the galaxy across challenging missions and game modes. to fix the lag you need to keep the PC on a full screen, while on other devices it runs smoothly
